problem_title: Recurring Fixing/Reparing Potholes — Lakshmi Devi Nagar (2019–2020)
problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Lakshmi Devi Nagar between September 2019 and July 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 20% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 63 pothole complaints.
26 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹27.0 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.27). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, unresolved_rate=0.20, description_severity=0.18.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Lakshmi Devi Nagar' matched to datameet243=36 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.539).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Lakshmi Devi Nagar for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 26 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
